reclassified.RG-12: the 403 on run start with an unpaired browser session is CORRECT fail-closed authority per ADR-0141 (coding runs require a launcher-attested paired session; serverPrincipal is empty otherwise). Residual defect: the readiness narration ('Workspace ready. Runtime ready.', header 'Ready to start') omits the pairing dimension - a paired-state readiness input is required (matches the F-08 remediation plan).

fixVerification.f08Deepened: the narrowly-scoped managed-root allow already exists (gitRoutes resolveManagedRepositoryRequest, files.ts managed branch) but requires a live launcher-attested app session; the session registry is process-memory with 30-min idle expiry, so after restart/expiry every managed read fails closed with content-free reason 'unknown' (intentional, ADR-0141 D6). Additionally a repository located under ANY deny-listed segment (e.g. .claude/worktrees/...) cannot be bound at all - observed live.
fixVerification.f11RootCause: memory-salience sends response_format with a root ARRAY schema and no json_schema.name; Azure structured outputs require a named root OBJECT - every salience call 400s when supportsResponseFormat is true. 'no-embeddings' is downstream: only the salience path embeds on capture; the regex-intent path inserts without vectors.
fixVerification.pendingHumanAction: full paired coding run (real OpenCode execution) requires the launcher-opened paired browser window - deliberately not circumvented
